brief:
Syria has condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's entry into its territory, characterizing the move as provocative, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu visited Israeli troops occupying southern Syria on Wednesday, prompting the Syrian government to issue a formal objection to what it described as an unlawful incursion.

Netanyahu traveled directly to troops stationed in the Golan Heights region, an area Syria views as occupied territory under international law. The visit marked a rare public appearance by an Israeli leader in the disputed zone.
